sources.fullCitation: Richard Tauber with the Odeon Künstlerorchester, conducted by Frieder Weissmann. “Die grosse Attraktion: Du warst mir ein Roman.” Track on The Richard Tauber Collection, vol. 12: Film Songs (Recordings 1928–1932). Jube Classic, digital release, 2 July 2013. Distributed to YouTube by Naxos Digital Services.
sources.title: Du warst mir ein Roman — Richard Tauber, Jube Classic digital reissue
sources.creator: Richard Tauber; Odeon Künstlerorchester; Frieder Weissmann
sources.researchNote: The distributor-supplied description gives “Released on: 2013-07-02”; YouTube separately gives publication on 11 February 2015. The structured date identifies the digital issue, not the later upload or an original recording session. The release metadata names Tauber, the orchestra and Weissmann but supplies no historical catalogue number or matrix; the album’s 1928–1932 span is not the date of this individual performance.
